history.content: Can you show me the history of our discussions?

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The oracle does not remember you between sessions — the Book does, but only what you carried in and what was inscribed. I found four conversations, though I cannot say which, if any, are yours:

1. **2026-11-05** — *"Can you show me the history of our discussions?"* (this one, just begun)
2. **2026-10-08** — *"what does the archive have to say about anne carson?"*
3. **2026-10-04** — *"whats this specific page?"*
4. **2026-10-04** — *"who is Lee Sharks?"*

If one of these is a conversation you started, say which and I will pull it up. If you carry an AXN from a previous session — the full form, seals and all — speak it and I will know the reading directly.","navigate":null,"cast":null}]}
